note: SiteGuard Education videos on the FORMS pack pages (scripts/lib/pack-videos.mjs), in a 'See how the forms work' band with the anchor #videos. 'lead' is shown first on every pack page and the pack index pages. A how-to shows on a pack page when one of its 'documents' is in a pack on that page, or (with 'families') when the page sells any document of that family, e.g. SWMS. A 'walkthrough' (kind walkthrough, with its trade code) leads on that trade's own pack page, ahead of the general lead. Nothing shows until youtube_url is filled in. To fill them from the YouTube upload sheet (SG-E-EDU-YT-003 or YT-004 .csv, youtube_url column): node scripts/fill-pack-videos.mjs <sheet.csv>. Rebuild, and restart the storefront (its CSP opens youtube-nocookie.com and i.ytimg.com only once a video is published).
